stories.title: Petition calls on UK Government to reject Connah’s Quay power station plans
stories.summary: A petition is calling on the UK Government to reject plans for a new gas-fired power station with carbon capture at Connah’s Quay. stories.title: North Wales Police officer awarded King’s Police Medal for football policing work
stories.summary: A North Wales Police officer who became Wales’ first female football policing officer has been awarded the King’s Police Medal. stories.title: Calls to end term-time only pay for school support staff backed in Senedd

stories.title: Councillor calls two-year wait for Synthite fire investigation findings “unacceptable”
